name: Integration Nightly

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  checks: write

jobs:
  generate-matrix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.set-matrix.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Generate matrix
        run: npx ts-node matrix-generator.ts --mode nightly > matrix.json
      - id: set-matrix
        run: echo "matrix=$(cat matrix.json | jq -c .)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  integration-nightly:
    needs: generate-matrix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.generate-matrix.outputs.matrix) }}
      fail-fast: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: .
          useLockFile: true
          useRollingCache: true
          install-command: npm ci
          cache-key-prefix: integration-nightly
      - name: Run integration test
        env:
          CONFIG: ${{ toJSON(matrix) }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: node integration-runner.ts

  community-tests:
    needs: generate-matrix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: .
          useLockFile: true
          useRollingCache: true
          install-command: npm ci
          cache-key-prefix: community-tests
      - name: Run community runner
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: node community-runner.ts

  all-green:
    needs: [integration-nightly, community-tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: re-actors/alls-green@release/v1
        with:
          jobs: '["integration-nightly","community-tests"]'
          allowed-failures: 0
          allowed-skips: 0
